notes.title: 🔧 Patch Notes – AI Behavior Balancing Update
notes.content:
We've just released a new patch focused on improving and balancing the AI behavior for a more immersive and fair experience. Here's what's changed:

AI Improvements & Balance Changes:
Improved AI Hearing Range:
The AI can now detect sounds from a slightly larger distance, making stealth more important.

Adjusted Footstep Detection:

Running steps are now quieter, reducing the chance of being detected when sprinting short distances.

Dropped items also produce less noise, allowing for more strategic interactions and baiting.

These changes aim to balance challenge and player freedom while maintaining tension in each encounter. We’ll continue tweaking AI behavior based on your feedback — keep it coming!

Thank you for playing and supporting the game!

notes.title: Nightfall Secrets - Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We've just released a small hotfix based on your feedback. The enemy spawn location has been adjusted to give players more time to prepare at the start of each match. This change should provide a fairer and more balanced experience, especially in the early moments of gameplay.[/p]
